Gameplay footage w/ commentary: Eden Star, an early access/pre-alpha sci-fi FPS open world sandbox survival game

Posting this additional info here because Eden Star seems like one of those rare early access titles that looks like it could really evolve into something exceptional.

Eden Star is developed by Flix Interactive and will soon be receiving an update adding multiplayer to the game.

Additional updates already in the works will expand on the type and variety of creatures in the game (neutral and hostile), as well expanding on the building options and available tools and weapons. During the day you can roam freely, gathering materials and exploring. At night, the atmosphere becomes toxic and it's usually a good idea to return to your base where you will not only provide protection from the harsh atmosphere, but where you will also have an opportunity to help defend your base against enemies who are attracted to your base's power core ('Eden Kit'). (The night assault depicted in this video is extremely tame compared to the one from the previous night. Sometimes they're fairly straightforward and other times the enemy push is relentless.)
The game does look promising. I'm hoping that when new content starts rolling out, that some of it will be stuff like new planets and ship building.
